esportes.significado: A player who fakes excuses, feigns injury, or exaggerates a situation to get out of training, tough marking, or responsibilities.
esportes.exemplo_correto: He always pretends his thigh hurts whenever it's time to mark the opponents, such a flopper.
exemplos_incorretos: The backup was flopping the whole game sitting on the bench without being called up.
He celebrated the goal in a very flop way, taking off his shirt and running across the field.
When it was time to take the decisive penalty, he flopped and kicked it wide.
significados_incorretos: A backup player who never gets picked by the coach.
A player who overdoes his celebrations after scoring.
A player who always fails at decisive moments out of nerves, like taking a penalty.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It attributes unsportsmanlike, uncommitted conduct to the athlete, who invents excuses to dodge duties and team effort.

esportes.significado: Used when a player does unnecessary flashy dribbles or tricks, usually to show off, with no real purpose toward the goal.
esportes.exemplo_correto: Stop showboating in the back and just clear that ball already!
exemplos_incorretos: The forward pulled off amazing showboating and celebrated with a cartwheel on the pitch.
The two players started showboating right after the nasty tackle.
His showboating led directly to the goal, the fans gave him a standing ovation.
significados_incorretos: An over-the-top goal celebration with multiple flips.
A heated argument between players during the match.
A successful flashy play that results directly in a goal.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It criticizes the excess of showing off and the player's lack of purpose, prioritizing individual spectacle over team efficiency.

esportes.significado: A goalkeeper with shaky hands who lets the ball slip easily, or who fails at theoretically simple saves.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The shot came in weak, right down the middle, but the butterfingers keeper let it go through.
exemplos_incorretos: The butterfingers defender gave away a silly penalty in the box again.
He's left-footed and has butterfingers on his shot, always kicks it weak.
The butterfingers keeper was out of position and got beat from long range.
significados_incorretos: A defender who tends to commit silly penalties.
A left-footed player with little kicking power.
A goalkeeper who's poorly positioned and gets beaten from distance.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It highlights the goalkeeper's technical insecurity, tying him to serious mistakes on easy saves that hurt the scoreline.

esportes.significado: To cushion the ball on your chest; by extension, to take charge of a tough situation and handle it calmly.
esportes.exemplo_correto: Don't worry about that project issue, I'll chest it down and get it sorted by tomorrow.
exemplos_incorretos: In jiu-jitsu, he landed a perfect chest it down on his opponent.
After the goal, he went to chest it down, hitting his chest hard in celebration.
The ball came in high and he chested it down with his foot before laying it off to a teammate.
significados_incorretos: A martial arts strike applied to the opponent's chest.
Celebrating a goal by pounding your chest.
Cushioning the ball with your foot before continuing the play.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It praises flawless ball control on the pitch and, more broadly, the leadership and courage of taking charge to solve problems.

esportes.significado: To win or lose a match by a very large margin of points or goals, like a lopsided rout.
esportes.exemplo_correto: Our team played amazingly, we beat them in a total blowout, it was 6-0!
exemplos_incorretos: The team went downtown for a blowout celebration after winning the title.
We won in a blowout on penalties, it was a super tight match.
The game ended in a blowout, 0-0, no goals from either side.
significados_incorretos: A team celebration after winning a championship.
A tight win decided on penalties.
A scoreless draw in a tightly contested match.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It indicates an overwhelming, undisputed victory, highlighting the dominance and superior performance of the winning team.

esportes.significado: To retire from a soccer career, or, by extension, to decide to stop doing any regular activity or profession.
esportes.exemplo_correto: After twenty years in the corporate world, the director decided to hang up the boots and go live at the beach.
exemplos_incorretos: He hung up the boots on the net after scoring the winning goal.
The forward hung up the boots and signed with the rival team midseason.
After the severe injury, he had to hang up the boots temporarily.
significados_incorretos: Celebrating a goal by hanging off the net.
Switching teams in the middle of the season.
Being out of the starting lineup due to a severe injury.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It describes the natural act of ending a cycle or retiring, without attributing a positive or negative tone by itself.

esportes.significado: A soccer player of terrible technical quality, with no skill or who performs very poorly on the field.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The new striker missed four open-net goals, he's a complete scrub.
exemplos_incorretos: That scrub in the stands started fighting with a fan from the other team.
The backup is a scrub, never trains properly and just sits on the bench.
He's a scrub, misses pass after pass, but he does run a lot on the field.
significados_incorretos: A fan who only goes to the stadium to pick fights.
A backup player who never trains hard.
A player who misses a lot of passes but hustles a lot.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It's a derogatory criticism that openly disqualifies the athlete's technical ability and skill.

esportes.significado: A serious mistake or grotesque error by the goalkeeper who fails to hold the ball, resulting in an easily savable goal.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The shot was weak and along the ground, but the keeper slipped and let in a howler.
exemplos_incorretos: The top scorer, nicknamed 'howler' by the fans, scored three goals in the match.
The defender gave away a howler in the box and the ref called a penalty.
It was a howler of a shot, no power at all, but it still went in.
significados_incorretos: An affectionate nickname for the team's top scorer.
A defender's mistake that results in a penalty.
A weak shot that still turns into a goal by luck.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It ties the goalkeeper's performance to an embarrassing, basic error that directly costs a goal.

esportes.significado: A player who doesn't perform as expected, disappears from the game, or dodges responsibility in high-pressure, decisive moments.
esportes.exemplo_correto: When it was time to take the decisive penalty, he faked an injury, a real choker.
exemplos_incorretos: He's a choker, he's gotten injured three times this month.
The choker in the stands wouldn't stop screaming at the team.
In the final stretch of the game, he choked and faked pain to leave the field.
significados_incorretos: A player who gets injured frequently during the season.
A loud fan who screams a lot during the game.
A player who fakes an injury to leave the game early.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It accuses the athlete of mental fragility and dodging responsibility in the most important moments of the match.

esportes.significado: A selfish player who holds onto the ball too much and avoids passing to teammates, trying to solve everything alone.
esportes.exemplo_correto: He chose to shoot from way out and missed, when I was wide open in the box, such a ball hog.
exemplos_incorretos: The team's ball hog always shows up late to Friday practice.
That ball hog missed an incredible goal alone in the six-yard box.
He's a ball hog, always prefers to risk a shot from outside rather than pass.
significados_incorretos: A player who always arrives late to practice.
A forward who misses a lot of easy goals.
A player who prefers shooting from outside the box instead of passing.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It criticizes the player's selfish conduct, disrespecting teamwork in an attempt to stand out alone.

esportes.significado: A very skillful dribble where the player passes the ball exactly between the opponent's legs and picks it up on the other side.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The forward hit the defender with a humiliating nutmeg and went through alone on goal.
exemplos_incorretos: After the goal, he did the nutmeg, a celebration of writing in the air.
The fullback delivered a perfect nutmeg into the box for the center forward to head in.
He pulled off a surprising back-heel nutmeg between the two center backs.
significados_incorretos: A goal celebration mimicking writing in the air.
A precise cross from the fullback into the box.
A surprising back-heel pass between two opponents.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It exalts the dribble's technical refinement and creativity, generating spectacle and beating the marker with elegance.

esportes.significado: A trick that consists of kicking the ball over the opponent's head and regaining control of it behind them.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The number ten pulled off a beautiful sombrero on the midfielder before crossing into the box.
exemplos_incorretos: He made the sombrero gesture with his hand on his head to celebrate.
He jumped higher than everyone and scored a sombrero header in the top corner.
He attempted a spectacular bicycle-kick sombrero that died in the back of the net.
significados_incorretos: A celebration putting a hand on your head like a hat.
A well-placed header in the corner of the goal.
A spectacular bicycle kick that turns into a stylish goal.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It highlights the individual play's brilliance and flair, applauded for beating the opponent through the air with mastery.

esportes.significado: A very classy finishing style, often on penalties, where the player touches under the ball so it rises slowly, chipping the diving goalkeeper.
esportes.exemplo_correto: He took the penalty with a Panenka down the middle while the keeper dove to the right.
exemplos_incorretos: After the goal, he pretended to dig up the pitch in celebration.
He hit a powerful toe-poke Panenka that rattled the top corner.
The Panenka on the free kick sailed over the wall and went in.
significados_incorretos: A celebration pretending to dig a symbolic hole in the pitch.
A hard toe-poke shot into the top corner.
A free kick that goes over the wall and in.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It praises the composure, class, and technical precision needed to pull off such a subtle, high-risk shot.

esportes.significado: A fan, journalist, or critic who's very annoying, constantly complains and only focuses on mistakes, never giving credit to their own team.
esportes.exemplo_correto: That guy is such a hater, the team won 3-0 and he still cussed out the fullback.
exemplos_incorretos: The hater backup asked to be transferred after sitting on the bench.
That commentator is such a hater, he only praises his own team, never criticizes.
That hater only roots for whichever team is winning trophies.
significados_incorretos: A dissatisfied backup player who asks to leave the team.
A sports commentator who always over-praises his own team.
A fan who switches teams depending on who's winning.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It describes toxic, excessive-complaint behavior that devalues the team's achievements and spreads negativity.

esportes.significado: In volleyball and tennis, a serve so good and powerful it lands directly in the opponent's court with no defense, resulting in an immediate point.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The match was tense, but the tennis player landed an unreturnable ace and won the match.
exemplos_incorretos: After the point, he made the ace gesture, raising his finger to the crowd.
The block was an ace, it stopped the attack right in the opponent's face.
He hit an ace-like spike, unreturnable, straight into the opponent's court.
significados_incorretos: A celebration made by raising the index finger.
A perfect block that stops the opponent's attack.
A powerful spike the opponent can't return.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It represents perfection in serve execution, guaranteeing a direct point and showing technical dominance.

esportes.significado: In surfing, it refers to small, weak waves. In everyday use, it means chilling out, relaxing, and avoiding effort.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The sea's all mush today, we won't even get to put the board in the water.
exemplos_incorretos: He celebrated the goal doing the mush gesture with his arms.
I bought a small mush to practice surfing with my kid.
It's mush out there today, only advanced surfers can catch anything.
significados_incorretos: A celebration mimicking a wave motion with your arms.
A small surfboard used by beginners.
A big, dangerous wave, ideal for experienced surfers.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It merely describes a calm sea state with little swell or an everyday moment of rest, without moral judgment.

esportes.significado: A desperate play in American Football where the quarterback throws a long pass into the end zone, hoping for a last-second miracle.
esportes.exemplo_correto: There were only five seconds left on the clock and he threw a heroic hail mary to win the game.
exemplos_incorretos: After the touchdown, the player did the hail mary, kneeling on the field.
The defense pulled off a hail mary by intercepting the pass on the final play.
With seconds left, the team attempted a hail mary long-distance field goal.
significados_incorretos: A celebration kneeling on the field after the touchdown.
A defensive play that intercepts the opponent's pass.
A decisive field goal kicked at the end of the game.
esportes.impacto_motivo: If successful, it becomes a miraculous, heroic act; if it fails, it highlights the team's desperation and failure.

esportes.significado: A very lucky person, or someone supposedly bringing good luck to the team or group of friends while watching the game.
esportes.exemplo_correto: I always invite my cousin to watch the final with us, the kid is such a lucky charm.
exemplos_incorretos: That lucky charm on the team always scores headers off corners.
He's a lucky charm, travels to watch every away game.
I only watch the decisive games, I'm a lucky charm at those moments.
significados_incorretos: A player who always scores headers.
A fan who goes to every away game.
A person who only watches the team's decisive games.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It ties the person's presence to luck and winning results, making them a beloved, sought-after presence in the group.

esportes.significado: A disloyal fan who switches teams depending on who's winning more titles at the moment, abandoning their old team.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The guy swore his love for the old club, but the rivals started winning everything and he jumped on the bandwagon in no time.
exemplos_incorretos: The fullback is a bandwagoner and played as a forward in the second half.
That commentator is a bandwagoner every week about who should be the coach.
He only shows up at the stadium when the team's in title contention, such a bandwagoner.
significados_incorretos: A player who switches positions mid-match.
A commentator who changes his opinion about the coach every week.
A fan who only goes to the stadium when the team is winning titles.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It condemns the person's lack of loyalty and opportunism, abandoning their sports passion in exchange for easy wins.

esportes.significado: A very important move in Jiu-Jitsu where the fighter goes over or around the fallen opponent's legs, reaching side control of their body.
esportes.exemplo_correto: He used a lot of pressure and weight to get the guard pass and finish with an armlock.
exemplos_incorretos: After the win, he celebrated by making the guard pass gesture with his arms.
He got the guard pass with a clean rear-naked choke from behind.
He got the guard pass with a quick sweep, flipping the position on the mat.
significados_incorretos: A celebration raising your arms in a cross shape.
A submission by choke from behind.
Applying a sweep to reverse the position on the ground.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It recognizes the tactical advance and the conquest of a dominant position in the fight, key to scoring or finishing.

esportes.significado: A very unlucky person, known for always bringing bad luck to their favorite team or the events they attend.
esportes.exemplo_correto: Don't even invite him to the bar to watch the game, every time he shows up our team gets scored on, such a jinx.
exemplos_incorretos: He's a jinx, always misses the decisive penalty in practice.
That jinx never goes to the stadium, prefers to watch from home.
He's only a jinx in decisive games, in normal ones the team wins easily.
significados_incorretos: A player who always misses penalty kicks.
A fan who never goes to the stadium to watch the team.
A person who only brings bad luck in decisive games, but not in normal ones.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It labels the person as a bad-luck charm, causing them to be avoided and teased by fellow fans.

esportes.significado: A term from English. A person who tries in an exaggeratedly competitive way in a casual game or amateur sport, wanting to win at all costs.
esportes.exemplo_correto: We were just kicking the ball around on the weekend to sweat a bit and the guy showed up sliding into tackles, such a tryhard.
exemplos_incorretos: The pro player is a tryhard, trains twice as much as the rest of the squad.
He only plays video games in serious competitive mode, never casual, such a tryhard.
He pretends to be a tryhard but deep down doesn't even care about the match result.
significados_incorretos: A pro player who trains twice as much as his teammates.
A person who only plays video games in serious competitive mode.
A player who pretends to try hard but actually doesn't care about the result.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It criticizes the lack of common sense in recreational settings, where the obsession with winning ruins the fun and relaxed atmosphere.

esportes.significado: Gym slang referring to physical conditioning and shape, especially when the body is muscular, defined, and attractive.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The guy did a strict diet and got jacked in time for summer.
exemplos_incorretos: I bought new jacked gear to train with more compression on my arms.
I drank jacked before training for more energy at the gym.
He got that jacked physique way too fast, he must be on something.
significados_incorretos: Compression clothing used for training at the gym.
A powder supplement taken before training.
A defined body achieved quickly through steroid use.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It praises the athlete's aesthetic refinement and discipline, recognizing the effort in training and the good shape achieved.

esportes.significado: A chess move where the player intentionally sacrifices a pawn or piece early in the game, aiming to gain a strategic advantage on the board.
esportes.exemplo_correto: To break down his defense, the Russian grandmaster decided to use the king's gambit on the third move.
exemplos_incorretos: After winning, he made the gambit gesture, mimicking a horse with his hand.
He landed a perfect gambit ending in checkmate.
His strategy was a defensive gambit, avoiding losing pieces right from the start.
significados_incorretos: A celebration moving your hand like a chess knight.
A final move that results directly in checkmate.
A defensive strategy that avoids losing pieces early in the match.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It classifies a neutral, technical chess strategy, whose value depends entirely on how the tactics unfold in the game.

esportes.significado: To be brutally knocked out in combat sports (Boxing, MMA), falling face or stomach first straight onto the ring floor.
esportes.exemplo_correto: He dropped his guard for a second, took a perfect cross to the chin, and went to kiss the canvas instantly.
exemplos_incorretos: After the win, he kissed the canvas raising his arms in the ring.
He took a huge shot and nearly kissed the canvas, but stayed on his feet.
He kissed the canvas on purpose, faking a fall to buy some time.
significados_incorretos: A celebration raising your arms inside the ring.
A powerful blow that drops the opponent without knocking them out.
Falling on purpose to fake a knockdown.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It portrays a crushing defeat by knockout, highlighting fragility and loss of consciousness in the fight.

esportes.significado: Bodybuilding and gym slang referring to the frequent use of anabolic steroids, said discreetly or jokingly.
esportes.exemplo_correto: There's no way a guy gains 30 pounds of muscle in two months just eating chicken, he's definitely on the juice.
exemplos_incorretos: I had an energy juice before going to the gym today.
The post-workout protein juice helps with muscle recovery.
His physique is all natural, just diet and training, no juice at all.
significados_incorretos: An energy drink taken before an intense workout.
A protein supplement consumed after training.
A naturally defined body achieved only through diet and training.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It can carry a humorous/admiring tone about big muscle gains, or a derogatory tone pointing to cheating and health risks.

esportes.significado: Repetitive bad luck, a prolonged jinx, or bad energy where everything goes wrong, often used when teams string together losing streaks or injuries.
esportes.exemplo_correto: This team hasn't beaten anyone in ten rounds, someone needs to lift that curse from the locker room.
exemplos_incorretos: He tapped his feet on the ground three times to lift the curse before taking the penalty.
The team is on a great curse, five straight wins without losing.
That player lives under a curse, always faking a little injury to leave the field.
significados_incorretos: A goal celebration tapping your feet on the ground three times.
A consecutive winning streak for a team.
A minor injury the player fakes during the game.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It expresses a persistent stretch of bad luck, misfortune, or negative energy that hurts the athlete's or team's performance.

esportes.significado: A woman whose main focus is meeting, flirting with, and dating soccer players specifically, chasing status and money.
esportes.exemplo_correto: As soon as the fullback signed his first million-dollar contract, jersey chasers started popping up all over his social media.
exemplos_incorretos: The jersey chaser spent ninety minutes on the bench without playing.
That jersey chaser never misses a game from the team, she's always there in the stands.
She's a jersey chaser, manages the careers and contracts of players.
significados_incorretos: A backup women's soccer player sitting on the bench.
A die-hard fan who never misses a team game.
An agent who manages the careers of soccer players.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It's usually used pejoratively to criticize financial interest, but can also come up in a neutral or informal way in sports circles.

esportes.significado: A highly decisive, ice-cold player who doesn't feel the pressure of the opposing crowd and manages to save the game or seal the point at the last second.
esportes.exemplo_correto: We were down by two points at the end of the last quarter, but he's so clutch he hit a three at the buzzer.
exemplos_incorretos: After the basket, he made the clutch gesture, putting his hand on his chest.
That backup player is clutch, only comes onto the court in the final minutes of the game.
He's great in practice but freezes in real games, nothing clutch about him.
significados_incorretos: A celebration putting your hand on your chest after a basket.
A backup player who only enters the game in the final minutes.
A player who stands out only in practice but freezes in official games.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It exalts supreme emotional control and the ability to close out games in the tensest, most decisive moments.

esportes.significado: A blend of 'gym' and 'bro.' The nearly inseparable gym friend who trains together every day and pushes you to lift heavier.
esportes.exemplo_correto: I texted my gymbro letting him know today's leg day and he's already waiting at the turnstile.
exemplos_incorretos: I hired a private gymbro to help me at the gym this month.
I downloaded a gymbro app to build my own workout plan by myself.
He's a solo gymbro, prefers to train alone at his own pace, no partner.
significados_incorretos: An instructor hired by the gym to give private lessons.
A workout app that builds your exercise plan.
A person who only trains alone, without a partner, focused on their own pace.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It values companionship, friendship, and mutual encouragement to stay consistent and progress in weightlifting.

esportes.significado: Going to the gym with no real motivation, lifting very little weight, stopping constantly to check your phone or chat, with no real effort or intensity.
esportes.exemplo_correto: She's always complaining the gym gives no results, but spends an hour on the machine scrolling TikTok, totally phoning it in.
exemplos_incorretos: The phone-it-in class, like light yoga, is on Tuesday mornings.
I phoned it in with a recovery session the day after leg day.
That workout was really phoning it in, an intense twenty-minute HIIT session.
significados_incorretos: A light yoga class offered at gyms.
A recovery workout done the day after an intense session.
A high-intensity interval workout done in a short time.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It scolds the lack of dedication and focus at the gym, mocking those who don't put in enough intensity to get results.

esportes.significado: A player who lives in the medical department, faking injuries or dragging out recoveries so they don't have to play or train.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The team's midfielder is made of glass, feels a twinge in his thigh and already asks for three months in the medical department.
exemplos_incorretos: The forward put on his glass shoes to take the decisive penalty.
The glass coach gave a tactics lesson in the weekend derby.
He scored a glass goal, chipping the free kick over the wall.
significados_incorretos: Special shoes worn by players for better penalty accuracy.
An experienced coach who uses simple defensive strategies.
A soft free-kick style chipped over the wall.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It shows a lack of professional commitment to the team, criticizing the athlete who avoids playing under the pretext of injury.

esportes.significado: To make a childish, unforgivable mistake in the match, handing the win or the advantage straight to the opponent.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The defender tried to pass it back without looking, the rival forward intercepted it, and the team handed it on a platter in stoppage time.
exemplos_incorretos: The forward handed it on a platter into the top corner with a shot from outside the box.
The fans handed it on a platter, singing from start to finish of the game.
The board handed it on a platter and signed three reinforcements from Europe.
significados_incorretos: Kicking the ball precisely into the top corner of the goal.
Cheering passionately and nonstop at the stadium.
Announcing major financial signings for the team.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It holds the athlete or team responsible for a basic, decisive mistake that results in a frustrating loss.

esportes.significado: A flashy dribble where the player traps the ball between their ankles and flicks it up behind them, going over the marker.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The winger pulled off a stunning rainbow flick on the fullback and burst clean through on goal.
exemplos_incorretos: The goalkeeper did a rainbow flick to save the shot in the top left corner.
The referee gave a yellow-card rainbow flick after the violent foul.
He took the penalty with a rainbow flick, hitting it hard down the middle.
significados_incorretos: An acrobatic save made by a goalkeeper using both hands.
A caution card given by the referee for unsportsmanlike conduct.
A hard, unspectacular penalty kick aimed at the center.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It exalts the individual skill, boldness, and technical polish of the player pulling off one of soccer's hardest dribbles.

esportes.significado: In tennis, the term used when a player wins a set 6-0, without conceding a single game to the opponent.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The world number one ran over the first set and served up an unquestionable bagel.
exemplos_incorretos: The tennis player swapped his racket's bagel in the middle of the second set.
The server hit a bagel in the middle of the court with a perfect smash.
The match went to a bagel tiebreak, super tight, in the third set.
significados_incorretos: A rubber accessory that protects the tennis racket's handle.
A smash hit into the center of the opponent's court.
A close, evenly matched tiebreak to decide the winner of the set.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It indicates an overwhelming, flawless win in tennis, showing total technical superiority over the opponent.

esportes.significado: The top corner of the goal (where the post meets the crossbar), considered the hardest spot for the goalkeeper to defend.
esportes.exemplo_correto: He struck the free kick with total mastery and put the ball in the top bins, no chance for the keeper.
exemplos_incorretos: The top bins of the team saved three penalties in the final shootout.
The forward shot weakly toward the top bins and the keeper gathered it in two motions.
The referee whistled top bins, signaling a handball in the box.
significados_incorretos: An affectionate nickname for a goalkeeper who specializes in saving penalties.
A weak, off-target shot toward the middle of the goal.
A referee's hand gesture signaling a foul.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It values the extreme precision and aim of the shot, resulting in a visually stunning, unstoppable goal.

esportes.significado: A dribble where the player pushes the ball past one side of the opponent and sprints past the other side to collect it ahead.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The winger pulled off a push and run on the defender by the byline and crossed into the middle of the box.
exemplos_incorretos: The goalkeeper pulled off a push and run to gather the ball in the air.
The fullback took the throw-in with a push and run into the box.
He scored the winning goal with a push and run header.
significados_incorretos: A vertical jump by the goalkeeper to grab the ball out of the air.
A throw-in taken with both hands above the head.
A powerful header aimed at the back of the net.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It praises the player's speed, quick thinking, and intelligence in using the space on the field against the marking.

esportes.significado: A situation where a coach completely outsmarts the rival coach's setup and strategies during a match.
esportes.exemplo_correto: With three changes at halftime, the coach gave the opponent a tactical masterclass and turned the game around.
exemplos_incorretos: The defender gave a tactical masterclass and committed a violent foul to stop the attack.
The fans put on a tactical masterclass with a beautiful mosaic in the stands.
The fitness coach gave a tactical masterclass training the athletes' running.
significados_incorretos: A violent foul committed by a defender to stop the play.
A paper mosaic put together by fans in the stadium.
An intensive running exercise coordinated by the fitness staff.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It recognizes the coach's strategic brilliance in reading the game and completely neutralizing the opponent's plan.

esportes.significado: In basketball, a shot so badly missed that it flies well wide, not touching the rim, backboard, or net.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The point guard tried a three without any balance and ended up throwing up an embarrassing airball.
exemplos_incorretos: He threw up a spectacular airball, slamming the ball through the rim with both hands.
The center grabbed the offensive airball and passed it to his open teammate.
The team celebrated the three-point airball at the final buzzer.
significados_incorretos: A powerful dunk made with both hands.
An offensive rebound grabbed by the center under the basket.
A decisive three-pointer made at the end of the game.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It exposes the player's lack of accuracy on the shot, resulting in a glaring error and boos from the crowd.

esportes.significado: A goalkeeper or defensive system (like a block in volleyball) that shows extreme efficiency and stops any opposing goal or point.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The keeper was a brick wall today, saved a penalty and three one-on-ones.
exemplos_incorretos: The brick wall forward missed every shot he attempted in the game.
The referee turned into a brick wall and added five minutes of stoppage time.
The team turned into a brick wall and conceded four goals in the first half alone.
significados_incorretos: A forward who misses shot after shot on goal.
A referee who adds a long stoppage time at the end of the half.
A disorganized defensive unit that concedes many goals.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It exalts the solidity, reflexes, and invulnerability of a defensive player or block during the competition.

esportes.significado: A financial incentive paid by third parties to a team so they beat a direct rival in the standings, without breaking the rules of the game.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The press speculated that the already-relegated team got a bounty to play with extra fight against the league leader.
exemplos_incorretos: The goalkeeper carried the bounty to store his training gloves.
The fans brought a huge bounty banner to support the club.
The referee used the bounty to stop the match for rain.
significados_incorretos: A sports bag used by goalkeepers to store equipment.
A giant banner or flag used by organized fan groups.
The referee's protocol for stopping matches during storms.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It's seen by some as a legitimate incentive for competitiveness, but by others as a questionable ethical interference in the competition.

esportes.significado: An illicit, corrupt payment offered to athletes or referees so they help the opponent win or manipulate the result.
esportes.exemplo_correto: Two players were banned from the sport after it was proven they took a bribe to throw the match.
exemplos_incorretos: The team celebrated the title by receiving the bribe on the podium.
The fullback's bribe helped the winger cross it first-time.
He scored a bribe of a goal, a screamer into the right corner.
significados_incorretos: A trophy handed to the champion team during the official ceremony.
A precise assist made by the fullback for the forward.
A powerful, well-placed shot into the corner of the goal.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It represents corruption and fraud in sport, destroying the integrity and credibility of the competition.

esportes.significado: Slang used to imply the officiating crew deliberately or incompetently favored a particular team.
esportes.exemplo_correto: With two nonexistent penalties called in their favor, the rival team won with clear help from the home cooking.
exemplos_incorretos: The coach used home cooking to set up the wall for the free kick.
The home cooking from the fans didn't stop for the full ninety minutes.
He scored the home cooking goal with a shot from midfield.
significados_incorretos: A signal used by the coach to organize the defensive wall.
Noise from musical instruments produced by the fans.
A goal scored from a long-range shot from midfield.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It questions the fairness of the match, suggesting injustice and improper favoritism promoted by the officiating.

esportes.significado: An extremely efficient, cold-blooded, lethal forward who needs few chances in the box to convert into a goal.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The ball fell clean to the number nine and he didn't forgive it, showing exactly why he's the team's poacher.
exemplos_incorretos: The poacher defender committed a hard foul and got a red card.
The stadium's poacher sold out every ticket for the big final.
He made a poacher's save, palming the ball over the crossbar.
significados_incorretos: A violent defender sent off for repeated fouls.
A staff member in charge of stadium box office and ticket sales.
A spectacular goalkeeper save, tipping the ball over the bar.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It praises the high conversion rate, precision, and goal-scoring instinct of a decisive center forward.

esportes.significado: To show cowardice, fear, or lack of resolve in a decisive moment, losing performance purely from pressure.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The team had been playing so well, but they bottled it in the final and caved to the opponent's pressure from start to finish.
exemplos_incorretos: The team's kit is yellow, so everyone went to bottle it on the field.
The referee bottled the goal for being scored with a hand.
He bottled the shot into the top corner and scored an unforgettable screamer.
significados_incorretos: Taking the field wearing the official yellow jersey.
Disallowing a goal for a handball offense on the play.
Landing a highly precise shot into the top corner.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It highlights the athlete's or team's psychological weakness in caving to nerves at crucial moments.

esportes.significado: A person or athlete with an extremely low body fat percentage and clearly visible, well-defined muscles.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The athlete prepared for six months on a strict diet and stepped on stage completely shredded.
exemplos_incorretos: The player got shredded with rage after being subbed off in the first half.
He made a shredded forty-yard pass to the left winger.
The athlete's shorts got shredded after the opposing defender's tackle.
significados_incorretos: Getting extremely angry after being taken off by the coach.
A long, highly precise pass played in depth.
A physical tear in the shorts caused by a tackle with the opponent.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It acclaims the rigorous physical discipline and the achievement of a top-level muscle definition.

esportes.significado: A state of physical and mental exhaustion caused by excessive training without proper rest and nutrition, leading to a drop in performance.
esportes.exemplo_correto: He trained hard seven days a week without resting, went into overtraining, and his lifts dropped off a cliff.
exemplos_incorretos: The team's overtraining helped them win in overtime.
I did a light overtraining, ten minutes on the treadmill to warm up.
He hired a personal overtraining to help him with the exercises.
significados_incorretos: Superior physical conditioning that ensures stamina late in the game.
A light cardio warm-up done before weightlifting.
A personal trainer specialized in high-performance workouts.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It warns of the health damage, injuries, and performance drop caused by excessive training without proper rest and balance.

esportes.significado: To kick the ball straight with the tip of your foot, with no technical finesse, prioritizing brute force over precision.
esportes.exemplo_correto: In a moment of panic, the defender didn't think twice and toe poked it away from the box.
exemplos_incorretos: The forward hit a curling toe poke that chipped the keeper with class.
The coach praised the perfect toe poke in the well-worked build-up play.
He took the corner with a sharply curving toe poke to the near post.
significados_incorretos: A stylish finish struck with the outside of the foot.
A short, highly precise pass in building up an attacking play.
A corner kick with a pronounced curve toward the near post.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It can be criticized for lacking technique in normal plays, but it's accepted and valued as an emergency defensive relief.

esportes.significado: To fail miserably or give up out of fear at the most crucial moment of the game or competition.
esportes.exemplo_correto: When it was time to take the penalty that would win the title, he shit the bed and skied the ball over the bar.
exemplos_incorretos: The forward shit the bed celebrating the goal with the organized fan group.
The team shit the bed and pulled off a historic 5-0 rout.
The coach shit the bed and made a perfect substitution in the second half.
significados_incorretos: Celebrating warmly with fans in the stands.
Dominating the game and winning by a wide scoreline.
Making a precise tactical substitution that secures the win.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It uses a crude/humorous tone to mock an athlete's failure or nerves at the crucial moment.

esportes.significado: A defensive move where the player slides across the pitch with their legs extended to steal the ball or intercept a pass.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The midfielder pulled off a clean slide tackle on the ball and masterfully stopped the opponent's counterattack.
exemplos_incorretos: The goalkeeper made a slide tackle with his head to save the high shot.
The forward celebrated the goal by sliding into the medical stretcher with the doctors.
He took the penalty with a soft slide tackle straight down the middle.
significados_incorretos: An acrobatic jump by the goalkeeper clearing the ball with his head.
An athlete celebrating by using the medical transport stretcher.
A weak, low penalty kick straight through the center of the goal.
esportes.impacto_motivo: If executed cleanly on the ball, it's a praised show of grit; if it's reckless or hits the opponent, it draws a foul and a card.

esportes.significado: To hit exactly the required weight class at the official weigh-in before a martial arts fight.
esportes.exemplo_correto: After weeks of dehydration and a strict diet, the fighter made weight and confirmed the title bout.
exemplos_incorretos: The defender made weight on the ball, sending it hard into the box.
The fighter made weight on his opponent and won by technical knockout.
He made weight at the final whistle, celebrating his team's win.
significados_incorretos: Heading the ball forcefully toward the middle of the box.
Beating the opponent until getting a technical knockout in the fight.
Celebrating enthusiastically at the final whistle of the game.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It reflects the athlete's professionalism, discipline, and ethical commitment to the rules of their sport.

esportes.significado: In Jiu-Jitsu and ground martial arts, it means doing practical sparring with a partner, applying techniques without intent to hurt.
esportes.exemplo_correto: At the end of Jiu-Jitsu class, the instructor called everyone to roll for ten minutes.
exemplos_incorretos: The forward hit a roll off the post with a shot from way out.
The goalkeeper rolled and conceded a goal through his legs.
The fans rolled onto the pitch after the referee's final whistle.
significados_incorretos: A hard shot that hits the goalpost.
A technical error by the goalkeeper letting in a goal through his legs.
A pitch invasion by fans after the match.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It's an everyday technical term from the routine of fight training, carrying neither a positive nor negative bias.

esportes.significado: A situation where a single player performs so brilliantly that they make up for their teammates' shortcomings and secure the win on their own.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The number ten carried the team all season, scoring goals and providing decisive assists.
exemplos_incorretos: The fitness coach had to carry every training cone on his back.
The defender committed a hard foul carrying the rival forward on his back.
The fans carried the banners on their backs up to the upper stands.
significados_incorretos: Transporting training equipment at the end of a session.
Committing a foul by shoving the opponent from behind.
Carrying flags and props up to the stadium sections.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It highlights standout individual leadership and the extraordinary ability to carry the team to success.

esportes.significado: A compliment used to describe a top-performing athlete, someone with impressive physical strength or extraordinary skill.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The center back played out of his mind today, cleared every aerial ball, he's an absolute beast at the back.
exemplos_incorretos: The team played so badly the press called the performance a beast.
The referee was a beast and gave an unfair red card in the first minute.
He committed a beast of an own goal, missing an open net.
significados_incorretos: A dismal, disastrous performance by a team.
A strict referee who makes controversial, unfair decisions.
A glaring mistake missing a clear chance to score.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It enshrines the athlete's vigor, presence, and extremely high standard of performance in their position.

esportes.significado: A gym beginner with little muscle mass who acts arrogant, performs exercises incorrectly, or wants to lift more than they can handle.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The ego lifter loaded 220 pounds on the bench press, couldn't lift it, and needed help so he wouldn't get hurt.
exemplos_incorretos: The personal trainer hired an ego lifter to be his assistant.
He's an experienced ego lifter, with ten years of steady training.
I had an ego lifter with sweet potato after my workout.
significados_incorretos: A technical assistant responsible for organizing the gym space.
A veteran practitioner with extensive experience and knowledge in weightlifting.
A protein meal eaten after training sessions.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It mocks inexperience combined with excessive vanity, leading to incorrect exercise form and behavior that becomes a laughingstock.

esportes.significado: An extraordinary goal, of rare beauty and technical perfection, worthy of being immortalized with an official tribute.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The forward dribbled past four defenders, chipped the keeper with a Panenka, and scored an unforgettable screamer.
exemplos_incorretos: The referee awarded a screamer after consulting the linesman's video.
The defender scored a screamer own goal, heading it into his own net.
The game ended in a screamer draw, dull and with no excitement.
significados_incorretos: A goal confirmed after checking the footage with the officiating team.
An own goal accidentally scored by the team's own defender.
A plain, unremarkable goal in a lackluster match.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It exalts the supreme beauty of an unforgettable play that goes down in the sport's history.

esportes.significado: A dull, uncompetitive match where both teams settle for the result (usually a draw) and avoid taking risks.
esportes.exemplo_correto: Since the draw would qualify both clubs, the second half turned into a total borefest with not a single shot on target.
exemplos_incorretos: The derby was an eventful borefest, with eight goals and three red cards.
The fans put on a borefest in the stands, singing nonstop.
The forward had a borefest, scoring three goals in the first half.
significados_incorretos: An intense, chaotic match packed with goals and red cards.
A chant duel put on by organized fan groups.
A brilliant performance by an athlete with multiple goals scored.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It criticizes anti-football, complacency, and the lack of competitive spirit, frustrating fans who expected a good contest.

esportes.significado: To intentionally slow down the pace of the game (taking forever on goal kicks, faking injuries) to burn time off the clock.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The keeper kept going down on the pitch after every save to waste time and hold onto the slim lead until the end.
exemplos_incorretos: The winger wasted time crossing the ball onto the forward's foot to score.
The fans wasted time lighting flares to celebrate the title.
The forward wasted time and blasted the penalty into the top corner.
significados_incorretos: Delivering a pinpoint cross onto a teammate's head.
Putting on a show with flares in the stands.
Taking a penalty hard into the top corner of the goal.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It condemns time-wasting and the anti-sporting tactic of dragging out the match to disrupt the opponent's rhythm.

esportes.significado: A behind-the-scenes change to the rules after the competition ends to save a club from relegation or benefit it improperly.
esportes.exemplo_correto: The club finished in the relegation zone, but the board went to court and pulled off a backroom deal.
exemplos_incorretos: The forward pulled off a spectacular backroom deal with a bicycle kick.
The backroom deal happened when the team came back from two goals down to win three.
The keeper pulled off the backroom deal, palming the free kick out for a corner.
significados_incorretos: A masterfully executed bicycle-kick finish by the forward.
A comeback on the scoreboard achieved in the second half of the match.
A crucial goalkeeper save, tipping the ball out for a corner.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It highlights the disrespect toward merit earned on the field, resorting to bureaucratic and political maneuvers instead.

esportes.significado: To reach the peak of a career, win every possible title in the sport, or pull off a perfect, undisputed achievement.
esportes.exemplo_correto: By winning the World Cup after already winning the Champions League and the Ballon d'Or, the star simply completed a clean sweep.
exemplos_incorretos: The team completed a clean sweep by getting routed in the tournament opener.
The referee completed a clean sweep by sending off three players from the same team.
He completed a clean sweep by missing the decisive penalty in the shootout.
significados_incorretos: Putting in a disastrous performance and getting thrashed in the first round.
A controversial referee performance handing out multiple red cards.
Making a crucial mistake by missing a decisive penalty.
esportes.impacto_motivo: It exalts the ultimate achievement in the sport, recognizing that the athlete reached perfection and the ceiling of the discipline.
